!!!First i have to say works perfect on Steamdeck!!!
Then I enjoy this game a lot, i'd say i played already 4-5h (Steam doesn't count offline hours somehow) 
So now about the game, the first few runs feel a little clunky but after U get used to the game rhythm it feels good an fits to the retro pixel style of the game.
I finished the game now in normal difficulty, but played the most time in hard difficulty.
And even i'm soulslike player its HARD so if U want a real challenge be brave and try!
I will write more about that when i made it in hard.
So lets talk about stuff that could be improved; i think the game starts to make the most fun after stage 1 (after first boss).
So the players have to get trough it to see the actual potentical of this game.
And then the farther u get the better it becomes!
The sound is really good i like it!
And considering this game is made by 1 person from sound->graphic everything!
its crazy!!!
i will play more & explore more!
And for everybody that couldn't find the multiplayer its the red bus in the camp;)

This is not the next triple-A game in your library. It was developed from start to finish by just one person, which is remarkable. After a little practice, you'll know the mechanics of the game and it becomes more fun with each level. The enemies get faster and you have to plan your attacks well or you won't survive long. I like the variety of weapons, there aren't many games where you can shoot others with a bag of ♥♥♥♥. The sound effects are a bit weak and should be improved. Nevertheless, a game that can be fun. Thumbs up.
Edit - played the game again now it is at - 1.0 status - I stand by my positive view that I had in the early access. Definitely the kind of game I will kill some time with in the evenings,
